question: What condition and scope of action accompany the performance of Vedic deeds?
premises: One becomes a wearer of rudrākṣa.
The action includes any deed whatsoever.
The deed is specified as Vedic.
inference: Having become a rudrākṣa-wearer, one may perform any Vedic deed.
plain_english: And having become a wearer of rudrākṣa, one may perform whatever Vedic deed.
